        self.dim = dim

        # We need at least 1 call per particle per generation
        max_generations = (budget - n_particles) // n_particles
        if max_generations < 1:
            max_generations = 1

        # Initialize Particles
        particles = rng.uniform(-5, 5, (n_particles, n))
        velocities = rng.uniform(-1, 1, (n_particles, n))
        
        pbest = np.zeros_like(particles)
        pbest_f = np.full(n_particles, np.inf)
        gbest = np.zeros(n)
        gbest_f = np.inf
        
        calls_used = 0

        # Initial Evaluation
        for i in range(n_particles):
            if calls_used >= budget:
                break
            f = func(particles[i])
            calls_used += 1
            pbest[i] = particles[i].copy()
            pbest_f[i] = f
            if f < gbest_f:
                gbest_f = f
                gbest = particles[i].copy()

        best_f = gbest_f

                # Update Position
                particles[i] = particles[i] + velocities[i]
                
                # Enforce Bounds
                particles[i] = np.clip(particles[i], -5, 5)
                
                # Evaluate
                f = func(particles[i])
                calls_used += 1
                
                # Update Personal Best
                if f < pbest_f[i]:
                    pbest_f[i] = f
                    pbest[i] = particles[i].copy()

                    best_f = f
                    best_x = gbest.copy()

            w = max(0.4, w * 0.95)
